column3: Description
An optional holding-company entity containing several Organizations; provides a cross-organization portfolio view.
A company or autonomous business unit; the primary RBAC and reporting tenant boundary.
The underlying business initiative (e.g., an ERP implementation) registered in the portfolio.
The people-side adoption initiative; links to zero or one Main Project (optional, many-to-many by design).
An individual or cohort segment affected by a change, with multi-dimensional impact scoring.
A single Awareness/Desire/Knowledge/Ability/Reinforcement score record for a person or cohort at a point in time.
A Bridges Transition Model and/or Kübler-Ross reading for an individual or cohort at a point in time.
A logged resistance instance with root-cause classification and closure action tracking.
Tracks executive sponsor visible-sponsorship activity and the guiding-coalition roster for a CM Project.
A member of the peer champion network, with site/department/shift assignment and activity log.
A logged champion listening session or focus-group record with mined themes.
A planned or sent communication record within a communication wave.
A curriculum track, session or job-aid assigned to a persona, with completion and competency tracking.
A People Manager's logged coaching note for a direct report, often AI-assisted (AIUC-11).
A 60/90-day post-go-live audit checkpoint record with regression audit outcome.
A visualized timeline marker (ADKAR transition, communication, training event) for an individual/cohort.
A logged change-adoption, sponsorship, saturation or platform risk with likelihood/impact scoring.
A governance, security or process control mapped to one or more risks.
A system-generated alert instance raised by a rule/threshold breach.
A single computed value of a D06 KPI at a point in time, feeding the Metrics & Analytics Dashboard.
A single AI-generated suggestion instance and its human decision outcome (accepted/edited/rejected).
A seeded AI Use Case Library definition (tier, module, trigger, output, human checkpoint).
An Organization's optional Real LLM Provider configuration (provider, model, browser-local API key reference).
A Project Management, Change Management or Framework-track task with baseline/actual dates and RACSI.
A Go/Go-with-Conditions/No-Go decision record bundling Phase Checklist completion, Composite Readiness Index and open flags.
A reusable WBS phase template (ERP 8-phase or Transformation Types 7-phase Common Lifecycle) seeded per project type.
One of the ten seeded reusable macro processes, each with its own SIPOC and macro-level RACSI.
One of the four seeded end-to-end process chains, each an ordered composition of Macro Processes.
A journi login (admin-provisioned or self-service) with role, scope and language settings.
A named role (Super Admin through Employee/End User) whose permissions are the product of role × scope.
A single role × capability cell in the runtime-configurable Permission Matrix grid (Section 3.4).
An audit-trail record of a score/state change with old value, new value, module, date and justification text.
A lightweight name/role/email entry for a Functional Process Owner or IT/Technical Lead, addressable in RACSI grids without a full login.
A qualitative or quantitative signal captured against the Section 2/5 Signal Catalogue (Must Have / Nice to Have), Macro-Process-taggable.
The Unfreeze/Change/Refreeze macro-state tag for a Change Management Project, updated as the project progresses.
